description: Search images on several engines and merge them into one list (mode balanced, the default); each image keeps its source engine and rank, and duplicates are dropped. Use it when one engine gives too few or too similar images; use image_search for a single engine. Balanced mode serves only the first page; mode any or fast returns the first engine that succeeds. Output fields match image_search. Cloud: any/fast cost 1 credit, balanced depends on engines and image volume. Errors return isError with status, error code and retry_after. On 429 or 503 wait retry_after; if an engine is blocked (CAPTCHA, 502/503), try another engine. Unsupported parameters return 400 and are not charged.

date.description: Published-date range YYYYMMDD..YYYYMMDD. Cloud web search supports Google and Ecosia; unsupported filters return 400 without charge.

dedupe.description: Drop duplicate URLs across engines (default true).

engines.description: Engines to query, in priority order for any mode. Omit to use all available engines.

features.description: Add serp_features (AI summary, answer box, People Also Ask, related searches) when the engine shows them.

file.description: File extension filter, such as PDF.

filter.description: Let the engine collapse near-duplicate results (default true, mostly affects Google).

format.description: json (default) for structured results; markdown, text or ndjson for compact plain text.

lang.description: Language code, such as EN or de.

limit.description: Maximum result count, 1-100. Keep 10 when paging with start.

merge.description: true (default): one list from every engine that succeeded. false: keep only the first engine that returned results.

mode.description: balanced (default): all engines in parallel, results merged. any: engines in your order until one succeeds; on Cloud slow attempts can overlap. fast: the healthiest, fastest engine. Only any and fast support start above 0.

region.description: Market or location hint, such as US, DE, en-GB, Berlin, or a Yandex lr id.

start.description: Result offset. On Cloud, Google/Bing/Yandex use multiples of 10, Baidu supports early pages, Ecosia any offset, DuckDuckGo none. Balanced mega requires 0; unsupported offsets return 400.

text.description: Search query text. At least one of text, site, or file should be provided.

name: mega_image
title: Mega Image Search
